**Given:** The full oriented collared and decorated data in the Statement, with full AC ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). The meanings of the fixed ribbon bordism, actual coupons, collars, boundary markings, weights and Lagrangians are [[def-weighted-lagrangian-ribbon-bordism]] and [[def-oriented-smooth-cobordism]].

[F1] [[lem-relative-three-manifolds-admit-parametrized-link-surgery-presentations]] supplies actual fixed-boundary link-surgery existence from the specified connected base, including the four-dimensional two-handle trace and its exact outgoing identification, componentwise.

[F2] [[lem-boundary-marked-five-bordisms-give-common-middle-two-handle-traces]] gives finite $O1/O3$ additions from two marked two-handle traces to two descriptions of one actual common four-dimensional trace, with its entire marked three-boundary fixed. Its actual integral signature-bordism input is part of that supplier. No same-trace two-equivalence assertion is included in it.

[F3] [[lem-fixed-vertical-height-relative-morse-handle-normalization]] supplies the exact cornered face convention and adapted handle data with projection height on a fixed vertical collar. [[lem-handles-of-equal-index-can-be-attached-on-one-level]] supplies the simultaneous disjoint attached-stage model. The actual quadratic-band and product-complement construction in [[lem-gluing-handle-morse-models-along-collars]], proof steps1.2–3.1, realizes each prescribed framed attaching tube and its outgoing map; on disjoint attaching regions these local constructions run in parallel at one critical height, with the vertical product complement retained. [[lem-relative-one-parameter-morse-path-with-finite-events]] joins the resulting endpoint functions with its supported finite fold/value event path. [[lem-relative-descending-path-with-finite-same-index-passages]] supplies the weak descending-field movie, finite isolated equal-index passages, the birth endpoint analysis and actual elementary maps, allowing positive-drop tangencies.

[F4] [[lem-parametric-index-grouping-preserves-a-relative-descending-path]] retains that field and the vertical height while ordering index heights and providing a finite transverse separated value-event list. [[lem-index-grouped-relative-descending-paths-give-based-framed-handle-movies]] proves the bounded-time based thickenings, event isolation, birth preparations and actual higher attaching-map transport.

[F5] [[lem-finite-relative-mixed-handle-movies-give-marked-kirby-moves]] converts this supplied based mixed-handle movie to finite $O2/O3$ moves with the specified cumulative outgoing map. It uses actual interior trades, tree comparisons, arbitrary replacement-arc comparisons and reversed disk-factor slides; it assumes no unrestricted four-dimensional two-equivalence theorem.

[F6] [[lem-decorated-graphs-lift-through-relative-surgery-calculus]] proves exterior graph representatives and finite framed graph/core crossing slides independently of its global hypothesis. Its marked decorated lifting conclusion is conditional only on the actual marked undecorated relative calculus; that hypothesis is proved in steps 2.1–4.1 below before the lifting conclusion is used.
